column3: `AWOL::clear_awol(person)`: ends the absence. Called by the end of the absence without a contract (0x418f60), by retirements (0x7a59e0) and by transfers (0x8c1af0, 0x8c2180, 0x8c9720). \n With the person and the flag table ([this+0xc]) not null and bit 1 of the person's flag set: flips the bit and removes the person's record from the absence list ([this]).

`AWOL::clear_missed_training(person)`: ends the missed training. Called by the missed-training check for someone left without a contract (0x418ff0, which the daily player update consults) and by retirements (0x7a59e0). \n With the person and the flag table not null and bit 2 of the flag set: flips the bit and removes the person's record from the missed training list ([this+4]).

`awol_post_missed_training_news(player, club)`: posts the 0xbc9 missed training news. Called by the missed training (0x41a360). SEH frame for the local news, no destructor. \n With a player who has a player sheet (+0x61) and a club with a manager (+0xcf): the news 0xbc9 (0x77bbe0) with the player (id and the +0x33 keys of +4, +8, +0xc), the club id, draw(3), whether the club is human-run (0x600a50 with 0, 1) and who reports it: the manager, if the club has a manager and is not human-run (0x600a50 with 1, 1; id and keys); otherwise, with draw(2), one of the 5 coaches (+0x19f, draw(5) until one is found or a thousand tries), and without the draw the assistant (+0xd3); with nobody (or id −1), −1 in all four. \n Human-run club (0x7875e0): sent to the player's club (+0x39, 0x7861e0); otherwise, if the player has a nation (+0x53) and his reputation (+0x61, +0xb) is above 7250, to the nation's inboxes (0x7863f0).

`AWOL::daily_update()`: resolves the day's AWOL cases, missed trainings and late arrivals. Called every day by the game loop (0x5cccd0). Three lists, each with its cursor at +0xa. 
 (1) Absences ([this]): the first one whose return date (+4) has passed ends (0x419710). 
 (2) Missed trainings ([this+4]): the first one a week past its date (+4) is resolved. Repeat case (byte +0xc), with two draws coming out zero, by the person's professionalism (+0x5b) and temperament (+0x5d): both drop by a draw and the person misses training again (0x41a360). New case: the teammates at the club (50 slots at +0xd7) under the offender's contract may ask to leave (0x867560 with 2) or lose professionalism, morale (+0x44 of the player) and temperament; and the offender, when draw(professionalism) is below draw(15) + 1, loses professionalism and morale, misses training again and falls out with the club (0x72c1f0 with 8). 
 (3) Late arrivals ([this+8]): the first one a week past (+8) that wins the draws loses professionalism and temperament or morale. 
 Each resolved case leaves its list (0x68d1f0) and bit 2 of the flag flips. A list that ends before the count ends the day.

`AWOL::has_missed_training(person)`: returns bit 2 of the person's flag; without a contract, clears the miss first. Called by the daily player update (0x5a69b0) and by the screens. \n Null person or beyond the count [0xae2364]: false. With bit 2 of her flag ([this+0xc] + id) set and no contract (0x4cf5a0, stored in [0xae1080]), clears the miss (0x4197c0) first. Returns bit 2 of the flag.

`AWOL::has_fitness_incident(person)`: true when the person has a record in the late arrival list. Called by the daily player update (0x5a69b0). \n Null person, beyond the count [0xae2364] or no late arrival list ([this+8]): false; otherwise walks the list (cursor at +0xa) looking for the person's record (id at +0). True in the low byte; the high bytes as the original leaves them in the register.

`AWOL::miss_training(person)`: the player misses training (or, if very unhappy, may go AWOL). Called by the day's missed trainings (0x5d6aa0) and by awol_daily_update. SEH frame only for the local date, no destructor. \n Player (+0x61) within the count, with a contract (0x4cf5a0, in [0xae1080]) at a club and without flag 2: if the contract has morale (+0x44) at or below −100 and bit 0x2000 (then 0x800) in +0x45, and draw(professionalism + 10) and draw(+0x59 + 10) both come out zero, he goes AWOL (0x419840 with 0, 0). \n Otherwise: sets bit 2, posts the missed training news (0x41a630, with the contract's club), byte +0xa of the 79-byte row ([0xae2d0c]) adds draw(10), the condition (0x62c590) drops by 25 × (21 − the player's +0x34) + draw + 100 (0x62bd10), and the record (person, today, case) joins the missed training list ([this+4], 0x68d0d0); the case byte, unset in the original, goes 0x90. AI club (0x600a50) with a manager (+0xcf, +0x69) and draw(his +0x14) not zero: the fine (0x5a5980, period 1 if draw(manager rating 0x544410 with +0x19) beats draw(5), else 2; reason 1).

`AWOL::end_absence(record)`: ends an absence. Called by awol_daily_update. \n With the person's flag (+0 id; [this+0xc] + id) not zero: if she has a contract (0x4cf5a0, in [0xae1080]) at a club, the return news (0x419ad0 with the person's club +0x39, 0 and −1); flips bit 1 of the flag (the original's `or 1` never gives zero) and removes the record from the absence list ([this], 0x68d1f0). Does not read an unset local.

`AWOL::report_poor_fitness(player, club)`: records a fitness incident and handles the reaction. Called by the daily person update (0x5ce2d0: the day's big drop in condition). SEH frame for the date and the local news, no destructor. 
 The record (player, club, today and a byte that in the original is stack leftover) joins the incident list ([this+8], 0x68d0d0, 0x11 bytes). 
 Human-run club (0x7875e0): one coach from the 5 slots (+0x19f, draw(5), until one is found or draw(20) comes out zero) and the news 0x138f to the club (the player, draw(2), his keys and the coach's, or −1). 
 AI club (0x600a50) with a manager (+0xcf, +0x69): draw(his +0x14) above draw(10) leads to the fine (0x5a5980, period 1 if draw(rating 0x544410 with +0x19) beats draw(5), else 2; reason 1).

`AWOL::is_player_awol(person, read_only)`: returns bit 0 of the person's flag; without `read_only` and without a contract or club, the absence ends first. Called by the squad selection, training, asking price, the staff day and transfers. \n Null person or id beyond [0xae2364]: 0 (only al). With `read_only`, bit 0 of the person's flag ([this+0xc] + id). Otherwise, with the bit set and no contract (0x4cf5a0, stored in [0xae1080]) or no club on the contract, the absence ends (0x4196a0); returns the bit read again.

`HostCountry::find_hosts`: the host (and the second host, for co-hosted editions) of competition `comp` in year `year` (short). \n The first entry of the competition with that year (or year 0) that already has the chosen bid (its two hosts), the fixed default or open voting (the default host), or, with `default`, voting still closed (the default). Writes both and returns how many are valid; with no entry, 0 without writing.

 Forward (strengths 0x40): lethal finisher, finisher or pacy goalscorer (by the sum index + strengths % 3), poacher, finisher or goalscorer (% 4), dynamic, powerful, strong, creative, exciting or skilful striker. Midfielder (position 0x10): with 0x40000 "inspirational" and on top "free-scoring" (returns 0); playmaker, ball winner, dynamic, hard-working, reliable, pacy. Strengths 2 (without 4): pacy or exciting full back; 4: pacy or technical defender. 
 Otherwise, by age (+0x18 of the person [0xae23bc] + 110 × index): veteran above index % 3 + 33 (without strength 1), rookie below index % 3 + 18 with +0x22 null and the sum % 3 = 0. 
 Returns the gender: with language 4, 1, 3 or 4 depending on the text; otherwise the byte `gender` (1 with language 5, which the original also writes into the argument itself; the copy does not write). Size < 30: the original (error box).

`staff_is_best_favoured_candidate(person, club, candidate)`: 1 if the candidate passes the favoured team mate filters (those of 0x548da0 without the position mask one) and none of the 50 in the club's squad (+0xd7) has a strictly higher score (the 0x548da0 score); 0 otherwise. \n First, the person's own filters: [0xb74350], id % 6 = r: +0x59 ≥ r + 6, +0x57 ≤ 15 − r, age (0x54cdb0) ≥ id % 28 + 14. The original stores the candidate's score in the argument `person` itself and a float in `candidate` (written before being read); the copy does not. Only `al`. Used in the media (0x758200).

`staff_get_player_strength_flags(person, other)`: the strength bits of the player (+0x61) for the media, scouts, search and transfers; `other` only needs to be non-null. \n Natural positions (1, 4, 2, 8, 0x10, 0x20, 0x40), 0x1000000 if the nibble of [0xae2d0c] + 79 × id + 0xb passes a draw(3) and 0x8cca10 ([0xde1f54]) gives 0, 0x80 by the sum of positions; then 19 draws (0x90cfc0) against the player's bytes, attributes (0x543540) and averages (0x7c1e30 on [0xb74350], weight 6.5, x87 in double precision with the `fstp dword` in between): 0x100 (+0x3c), 0x200 (+0x37 plus the adjustment of averages 0x16/0xd/5/1), 0x800000 (average 0xe above 8), 0x400 (+0x39, +0x3e and average 0xe or attribute 0x17 with averages 7 and 0x16), 0x800, 0x1000, 0x2000 (+0x2e, +0x40, +0x44), 0x4000, 0x20000, 0x100000, 0x200000, 0x400000 (attributes 4, 0xd, 0x14, 0x15, 1), 0x8000 (+0x21), 0x10000 (attribute 0xb and average 0xf), 0x40000 (reputation and averages 6/2 and 6/1), 0x80000 (averages 0x15, 0x10, 2 and 1). \n The original stores floats in the arguments themselves (written before being read); the copy does not. Nulls: 0.

`staff_get_player_weakness_flags(person, club)`: the weakness bits of the player (+0x61) for the media. \n Natural positions (0x20, 0x10, 0x40, 0x80, 0x100, 0x200), 0x800000 by the sum of positions; then the draws (0x90cfc0, some with n = −50) against bytes of the person and of the player, attributes (0x543540), averages (0x7c1e30, weight 6.5) and the word 0x62c3d0 ([0xb63d28]): 1 (the person's +0x5d and averages 0xb, 0xa and 1), 2 (+0x3c against a draw of 4, 7, 8 or 11 by +0x34 and 0x62c3d0), 4 (starter, slot 0..10 of 0x8972c0 on [0xde1d08], with the 0x6e6340 score of the 0x5b2ae0 slot below 150 + draw(40)), 0x400, 0x800, 8, 0x1000, 0x2000, 0x4000, 0x8000, 0x10000, 0x20000, 0x40000, 0x80000, 0x100000, 0x200000, 0x400000. \n The original stores bytes and floats in the arguments themselves (written before being read; the slot passed to 0x5b2ae0 is the `club` argument with the slot byte over it, and the copy builds it the same way); the copy does not write into them. Nulls: 0. Used in the media (0x72c1f0, 0x487c70).

`database_count_club_physios(club)`: how many of the 3 physios (+0x1cf) of the club and of its linked B team (0x540a50) are valid people (not null, id +0 < [0xae2364], signed). Only `al`. \n Null club: the original (error box and 0). Used in the person screens (staff_screens, 0x8740c8 and 0x87412b).

`club_is_b_team(club)`: 1 if the club has a partner (0x540a50 with `active`) and is its B team (`is_a` = 0), otherwise 0 (the whole eax). \n The local `is_a` is only read when there is a partner, and then 0x540a50 has written it. Null club: the original (error box and 0). Used in the person screen (staff_screens, 0x87272d).

`club_collect_non_playing_staff(club, out, max)`: puts into `out` the people outside the club's squad and then those of the linked B team (0x540a50 with `active`), in job order: the 6 from +0xbf (manager, assistant, ...) and the 15 from +0x19f (coaches, scouts, physios), the non-null ones, up to `max` (signed byte); returns how many in `al`. \n Null club: the original (error box and 0). Used in the info tab of the club screen (club_screen_draw_info_tab 0x460590, 0x4616fa).

`staff_is_player_attribute_visible(viewer, person, attribute)`: 1 if the viewer sees the person's attribute (signed byte); in `al`. \n Visible without any check: `viewer` or `person` null, no fog table ([0xae2a60]), fog turned off ([0x9cc270] = 0), no record for the viewer (fog_of_war 0x5afde0, thiscall on the table) or knowledge (0x5b02f0, thiscall on the record) 3. Knowledge 1 or 2: attributes 1, 0x11, 0x15, 0x1a and 0x1b always; the others by the remainder of the person's id by 4 (`m`): the shifted attribute (0, 1, 2 or 3 depending on `m`) divisible by 4 (knowledge 1) or by 2 (knowledge 2), or the next one (m = 0) / the same one (m ≠ 0) divisible by 3. Other knowledge: 0. Only `al`. \n 0x5b02f0 stores the last club found in [0xae1080] (the same value in both). Used in the search and filter screens (search_screens, SearchFilters 0x807450), the person screen and the club screen.

`staff_get_player_attribute_for_viewer(viewer, person, attribute)`: the attribute (1 to 0x1f, signed byte) of the person's player record (+0x61) as the viewer sees it. \n With the fog on ([0x9cc270]), a viewer who has a record (0x5afde0) and does not see the attribute (0x543280, through the game's address) gets 0xf9 (-7, "unknown"); otherwise the value of staff_compute_player_attribute (0x543540). Only `al`. Null person or attribute out of range: the original (error box and 0xff). Used in the player comparison and the person profile (staff_screens 0x877470, 0x879ac0, 0x87a754).

`database_get_non_player_attribute_name(attribute, text, size, abbreviated)`: writes into `text` the name of the manager attribute (1 to 12, signed byte), abbreviated or full, from the translated Langlib text (0x66f4e0, through the game's address); returns 1. \n Attribute out of range, null text or size (signed short) below 100: the original (error box and 0). Used in the search screens (search_screens) and the person profile (staff_screens 0x87ad97).

`database_compare_staff_by_surname(a, b)`: qsort comparison of person pointers by the style-4 name ("surname, first name", 0x53dba0 into 0x7d0 bytes) through the text comparison 0x90c1d0 (case-insensitive, `compare_text_nocase`). \n A null person counts as the empty text (the original zeroes the first byte of both locals beforehand). Used in the contract offer screen (contract_screens 0x4de5d0).

`database_compare_clubs_by_reputation(a, b)`: qsort comparison of club pointers by reputation (+0x80, signed short; null club = 0), highest first: `a`'s lower: 1; higher: -1; equal: 0. \n (0x540020, already in Rust, is the same order over ids.) Used in the club's teams menu (0x482070) and the Arrange Friendlies tabs (find_screens 0x5a1480, 0x5a1e10, 0x5a2250).

`database_club_nation_is_eec(club)`: 1 if the club's nation (+0x53) is not null and is in the EEC (+0x7f = 2), otherwise 0 (the whole eax). \n The club is not checked (the original reads its +0x53). Used in the info tab of the club screen (club_screens 0x462070, the foreigners).

`get_regions_sorted_by_name(language)`: fills the global array of the 14 regions (0xae2104) with 1..14, stores `language` (byte) in [0xae232b] and sorts it with the CRT qsort (0x945333) using the comparison 0x545e00 (through the game's address); returns the array. \n Used in the search screens (search_screens 0x80970c, 0x814b7e, 0x815d5e: the region filter).

`compare_region_names(a, b)`: qsort comparison of region bytes by name (0x616f20, from index.cpp, into 0xc8 bytes, in the language of [0xae232b]) through the text comparison 0x90c1d0 (case-insensitive); null `a`: 1; null `b`: -1. \n 0x616f20 zeroes the first byte of the text before anything else (the locals are never read unset). Called by 0x545dc0.

`staff_get_opinion_link_staff(person, target)`: the person at the other end of the person's opinion link, or 0. \n In the person's record ([0xae2d0c] + id × 79; null person or id >= [0xae2364]: 0), with a link (+0x27 ≠ -1): if the target is +0x37, the person of index +0x27 ([0xae23bc] + 110 × index); otherwise, if the target is +0x4b, the one of index +0x3b; otherwise 0. Used in the transfers tab of the person profile (staff_screens 0x87dd80).

`staff_add_disliked_club(person, club, force)`: puts the club among the person's three disliked clubs (preferences +0x65: +0x10/+0x14/+0x18). \n The club already dislikes the person (+0xa7..+0xaf): nothing; the club is a favoured one (+4..+0xc): it stops being one and the routine stops; otherwise the first free slot (without checking whether it is already among the disliked, as in the original); with no free slot, with `force`, a random slot (0x90cfc0, 3). Null person, preferences or club: nothing. \n Used in the daily person update (game_daily_staff_update 0x5ce2d0, two calls), 0x5a5980, MANAGER_MANAGER (0x69c030) and others.

`staff_fade_staff_relationships(person)`: each of the three favoured people (preferences +0x1c..+0x24) present leaves when a draw (0x90cfc0) of (the person's +0x59, signed) + 15 gives 0; each of the three disliked ones (+0x28..+0x30), with a draw of 35 − (+0x5d). \n One draw per occupied slot, in order. Null person or preferences: nothing. Used in the daily person update (game_daily_staff_update 0x5ce2d0).

`staff_get_disliked_staff(person, out, n)`: zeroes the byte `*n` (always, before checking the person) and copies to `out` the disliked people present (preferences +0x28/+0x2c/+0x30), in order, counting in `*n`. \n Null person, preferences or output: only the zero. Returns `n` (the original's eax); callers read only the byte. Used in the daily person update (0x5ce2d0, two calls), MANAGER_MANAGER (0x693850), the media and the person screens.

`staff_get_natural_position_mask(person)`: the mask of the positions where the player (person +0x61) is natural (20). \n No person or player: 0; goalkeeper (+0xf) 20: 1. Otherwise, by the player's signed bytes: +0x18 (0x80; 0x180 with +0x19 > 10), +0x17 (0x800; plus 0x400 with +0x19 > 10), +0x19 (0x700), +0x10 (2), +0x11 (4), +0x12 (0x18), +0x13 (0x38), +0x14 (0x30), +0x15 (0x40; plus 0x700 if none of +0x10..+0x14 is 20). With none: the first position from +0x10 to +0x14 at 15 or more gives 2, 4, 0x18, 0x38 or 0x30; +0x15 at 15 or more gives 0x740 (0x40 if any of +0x10..+0x14 is 20, which cannot happen there); otherwise 0x10. \n The original stores three bytes in a local (written before being read) and one in the argument itself; the copy does not. TapeCall at 37 points: the favoured team mate pick (0x548da0, in the daily person update), the match engine (0x6b7f20), the media (0x758010/0x758200, 0x72c1f0), awards (0x768cf0) and the person screens.

`club_count_squad_with_position_mask(club, mask)`: how many of the 50 in the squad (+0xd7) with a player record (+0x61) have a natural position mask (0x5481a0, through the game's address) equal to `mask`. \n Only `al` (the three callers, 0x758010 and 0x758200, read the byte). Used in the media.

`staff_pick_favoured_team_mate(person, club)`: the squad mate the person picks as favoured, or 0; the one with the highest score. 
 Needs the person, the club and [0xb74350]; id % 6 = r: +0x59 ≥ r + 6, +0x57 ≤ 15 − r and age (0x54cdb0 on 0xae2c90 with +0x3e/+0x42) ≥ id % 28 + 14. 
 Each of the 50 (+0xd7) with a player record, id below [0xae2364], not the person herself, (summed ids) % 3 ≠ 0, not disliked by the person (+0x28..+0x30), with +0x5a ≥ 11 or a mask (0x5481a0) different from the person's, with a contract (0x4cf5f0 on [0xae1050]), reputation (the player's +0xb) above 4250 and above (the club's +0x80) − 750, outside 0x8cca10 ([0xde1f54], 0) and with the player's +5 above 100 gets a score: the reputation; +500/+250 if the average 0x7c1e30(6, 17, 6.5), rounded to float, beats the ratio of [0xb74350] (+0x10/+0x18, or 6.8) + 0.2/+0.1, when 0x7c1e30(6, 1, 6.5) is above 5; +1250 if already favoured; +75/+50 by the player's +0x21 (20 / above 15); +250/−100 by +0x5b (above 15 / below 6); + (summed ids) % 500; +750/+300/+150 by the contract level (+0x4f >> 4 = 1/2/3); a compatriot (+0x1a) of a person from outside the club's country (+0x53): +1750 with contract +0x45 & 0x20020, otherwise +250 (age below 350 and +0x18 below 24) or +125. 
 The one with the highest score is kept (strictly above −10000 and above the previous one). Calls go through the game's address. All locals are written before being read (the original uses the argument itself as a cursor). Used in the daily person update (game_daily_staff_update 0x5ce2d0) and the person screen (0x87dd80).

`club_nation_is_not_argentina(club)`: 1 if the club's nation (+0x53) does not have the id of the Argentina key 0x9cf218; null club or nation: 0. \n The answer goes in `al` and the rest of eax is that of the id (`setne al` after `mov eax, [eax]`), as in the original. In the career: discipline (0x55e300), the daily manager update (manager_manager 0x6ab800) and the news (0x782f70).

`club_nation_not_argentina_france_croatia(club)`: 1 if the club's nation does not have the id of Argentina 0x9cf218, France 0x9cf300 or Croatia 0x9cf2ac; null club or nation: 0. \n In `al`; the rest of eax is that of the id. In the career, through the daily manager update (manager_manager 0x6ab800).

`database_is_melanesian_nation(nation)`: 1 if the nation has the id of one of the keys 0x9cf41c, 0x9cf478, 0x9cf530, 0x9cf2f8, 0x9cf500 (the Melanesian ones), otherwise 0. \n Used in the Oceania cups (oceania_club_champ 0x798220, oceania_nations 0x799e30).

`database_is_polynesian_nation(nation)`: 1 if the nation has the id of one of the keys 0x9cf4d0, 0x9cf52c, 0x9cf4b4, 0x9cf2a4, 0x9cf514 (the Polynesian ones), otherwise 0 (the nation is not checked). \n Used in the Oceania cups (oceania_club_champ 0x798220, oceania_nations 0x799e30).

`database_get_coaching_job_name(job, gender)`: the job name (signed byte) in the fixed text 0xae1980, through the jump table 0x53acc8: 5 and 12 "Manager", 6 and 13 "Assistant Manager", 8 and 15 "Coach" (translated by 0x66f4e0); the others, empty text. \n With `gender` not null and the language (0x66f4d0) 4, writes into it 4 (manager, assistant) or 1 (coach). Returns 0xae1980. Used in the regeneration (player_regen 0x7a9650).

`database_format_years_between_dates(end, start, text, size)`: the full years between the dates (+0 day of year, +2 year, words): year(end) − year(start), minus 1 if the start day is later (signed); written into `text` with "%d" (0x98806c) as an unsigned word (a negative becomes 65535). Returns 1. \n Null text, size < 5 or one of the dates null: the original (error box and 0). Used in the club and competition records screens (0x44aa20, 0x4a5690, 0x4a7f50).

`database_compare_clubs_by_short_name(a, b)`: qsort comparison of club pointers by short name (+0x38) through the text comparison 0x90c1d0 (case-insensitive); a null club counts as the empty text. \n The original copies both names to the stack before comparing; the copy compares in place (0x90c1d0 only reads). Used in the club and search screens, in Setup (0x822260) and in the UEFA seeding (0x906410).

`database_compare_staff_by_full_name(a, b)`: qsort comparison of person pointers by the style-1 name ("first name surname", 0x53dba0 into 0x7d0 bytes) through the text comparison 0x90c1d0 (case-insensitive); a null person counts as the empty text. \n Used in the menu (0x7612c0) and the transfer manager (0x8e55f0).

`database_staff_matches_names(person, first, surname, common, date)`: 1 if the person, who must have a player record (+0x61) or a non-player record (+0x69), matches: each non-null name (+4, +8, +0xc) has the requested id (+0x33) and, with `date`, the birth date (+0x10 day, +0x12 year) is the same (0x4a7f20); otherwise 0. \n Null person: the original (error box and 0). Used by screens, regeneration and transfers (~137 callers).

`database_compare_clubs_by_latitude(a, b)`: qsort comparison of club pointers by the latitude (+0x23, f64) of the city (+0x38) of the stadium (+0x69), lowest first; no city: 0. \n Null club: the original (error box and 0). Used in the cups drawn by region (eng_auto_cup 0x56b730, cro_a1, fin_prm, ita_ser_a, nor_prm, por_prm, spa_first, swe_cup).

`club_has_enough_defenders(club)`: whether the club has enough good defenders. Null club: 0. \n If the club concedes more than 1.35 goals a game ([0x969588]; goals conceded +0x6a of the statistics / games): 0. Otherwise 1 when more than 2 defenders (position +0x11 = 20) without serious injury are above the ability limit (reputation/65 + 40, from 40 to 145). Only `al`. Only by the scout (PLAYER_SEARCH::run_scout_day 0x7b3e20, report on a club).

`club_has_enough_hard_workers(club)`: null club: 0; otherwise 1 when more than 4 players (any position) without serious injury are above the ability limit reputation/65 + 40 (from 40 to 140) with attribute +0x44 (signed byte; the same one 0x549850 uses) above 14. \n Only `al`. Only by the scout (PLAYER_SEARCH::run_scout_day 0x7b3e20, report on a club).

`club_has_fit_goalkeeper(club)`: 1 as soon as one of the 50 in the squad (+0xd7) is a person with a player record (+0x61) who is a goalkeeper (+0xf = 20), without serious injury (0x62c400 ≠ 2) and with id < [0xae2364]; none or null club: 0. \n No ability limit. Only `al`. Only by the scout.

`club_lacks_fast_defenders(club)`: null club: 0; otherwise 1 when at most 1 defender (position +0x11 = 20) passes the limits (as in the previous checks) with attribute +0x36 (pace) above reputation/500 + 5 (at most 10). \n Only `al`. Only by the scout.

`club_has_two_creative_midfielders(club)`: null club: 0; otherwise 1 when more than 1 midfielder (position +0x14, +0x12 or +0x13 = 20) without serious injury passes the limits with attributes +0x43 and +0x37 (signed bytes) above reputation/500 + 5 (at most 14). \n Only `al`. Only by the scout.

`club_squad_strength_band(club, other)`: the squad strength band, 0..6. Null club: 3. \n Gathers those in the squad (+0xd7) with a player record (+0x61) and id < [0xae2364] (read once) into a local array of 50, sorts it with the CRT qsort (0x945333) using the comparison 0x549c30 (through the game's address) and sums the current ability (the player's +5) of the first min(n − 1, 16). With nothing summed: by reputation (+0x80; > 7250: 6, > 5750: 5, > 4750: 4, > 3250: 3, > 2250: 2, otherwise 1); otherwise by the average (> 155: 6, > 135: 5, > 110: 4, > 85: 3, > 60: 2, > 40: 1, otherwise 0). \n With `other` (the scout's club): its reputation > 7250 takes off 2 if the club's is < 4250 and the band > 2, and 1 more if the club's is < 7250 and the band > 0; otherwise, its reputation < 4250 adds 1 if the band < 5. In the same competition (+0x57 equal), a reputation gap (16 bits) > 1250 takes off 1 (band > 0, byte +4 of the table [0xae2d14] of 6 bytes per id: the other's ≥ 0 and the club's ≤ 0); < 1250 adds 1 (band < 5, the club's ≥ 0 and the other's ≤ 0). At the end, between 0 and 6. Only `al`. Only by the scout.

`club_reputation_for_staff(club, person)`: the club's reputation (+0x80) as seen by the person. \n No division (+0x57): the reputation. With the division's league ([0xadadfc][id]) and the division's reputation (+0x69) × 500 above the club's: the position (0x4a4850 on the league's table +8; no row: 0) scaled to 20 clubs (+0x3e) gives the weight from table 0x9b59c0; with fewer than 20 games (+4 of the row) it is mixed with the weight of the previous position (+0x5f, if +0x5b = +0x57; otherwise 1.3) × 0.05; if the person plays (+0x61) and the contract is with the club, adds the average 0x7c1e30(data, 6, 20, weight) and divides by 2, and gets ±500 from the preferences (favoured or disliked club); the weight becomes x = 14p − 18 between 0 and 10 and the result is ((10 − x) × reputation + x × division × 500 (16 bits)) / 10 truncated, plus the ±500. Otherwise: the reputation ±500 (a person who plays, with a contract at the club). \n Callers read only `ax`; the rest of eax follows the original (the register left over on each path). Writes [0xae1080] (the contract found). Used in the daily person update (game_daily_staff_update 0x5ce2d0, two calls).

`staff_remove_favoured_club(person, club)`: removes the club from the person's three favoured clubs (preferences +4/+8/+0xc, the first one that matches). \n Null person, preferences or club: nothing. Returns the original's eax (the preferences; null person: 0). Used in the daily person update (0x5ce2d0), when the attachment to the club ends.

`club_remove_favoured_staff(club, person)`: removes the person from the club's three favoured people (+0x9b/+0x9f/+0xa3, the first one that matches). \n Null club or person: nothing. Returns the club (the original's eax). Used in the dispute hearings (DISPUTE::process_hearings 0x569ed0).

`staff_remove_favoured_staff(person, target)`: removes the target from the person's three favoured people (preferences +0x1c/+0x20/+0x24, the first one that matches). \n Null person, preferences or target: nothing. Returns the original's eax (the preferences; null person: 0). Used in disputes (0x569ed0), squad relationships (game_update_squad_relationships 0x5d6d10, daily), the return from injury (0x630ee0), MANAGER_MANAGER (0x697a7a) and the media (0x75a340).

`staff_remove_disliked_staff(person, target)`: clears the first of the person's three disliked people (preferences +0x28/+0x2c/+0x30) that is the target. \n Null person, preferences or target: nothing. Returns the original's eax (the preferences; null person: 0). Used in squad relationships (game_update_squad_relationships 0x5d6d10, daily), the return from injury (0x630ee0) and the media (0x7414ac, 0x75a340).

`staff_get_favoured_staff(person, array, n)`: zeroes the byte `n` and, with person, preferences and array not null, copies the non-null favoured people (preferences +0x1c, +0x20, +0x24, in that order) to `array[n]`, adding 1 to `n` for each (the first goes straight into `array[0]`). \n Returns `n` (the original's eax). Used in MANAGER_MANAGER: the board's opinion of the squad (0x693850) and its reaction to the match (0x6aaee0).

`club_is_in_season(club)`: null club, 0; otherwise what `key_nation_club_in_season` 0x669bd0(club, null, null) returns (1 = today is inside the season of the club's nation), the whole eax (the default contract 0x864550 tests eax). \n At creation: the people's default contract (CONTRACT_MANAGER::initialise_all_staff_contracts → 0x85e960 → 0x864550) and the default wage of the initial lists (0x83a1b0 → 0x862720).

`club_is_in_major_nation(club)`: 1 if the club's nation (+0x53) has the id (+0) of one of the index.cpp keys England 0x9cf2e4, France 0x9cf300, Germany 0x9cf314, Italy 0x9cf360, Spain 0x9cf488 or Holland 0x9cf338; null club or nation: 0. \n Only `al` (the rest of eax is the nation's id). At creation, through the default contract (0x864550) and the default wage (0x862720).

`nation_is_major_nation(nation)`: the same six-key test as 0x549e50 on the id (+0) of the nation itself; null: 0. \n Only `al`. In the career, through the youth regeneration (PLAYER_REGEN::regenerate_as_youth_player 0x7abac0).

`staff_clear_opinion_links(person)`: −1 in both links (id and value) of the person's contract (+0x27, +0x37, +0x3b, +0x4b); null person or id ≥ [0xae2364]: nothing. \n At creation, for each generated contract (0x85e960, through CONTRACT_MANAGER::initialise_all_staff_contracts); in the career, in offers and complaints.

`staff_add_opinion_link(person, other, value)`: with both people valid (not null, id < [0xae2364]), writes the id of `other` and the `value` into the first link if it is empty (+0x27 = −1), otherwise into the second (+0x3b/+0x4b, overwriting whatever is there). \n In the career, through the contract events (0x867700).

`staff_remove_opinion_link(person, value)`: empties (−1 in the id and the value) the first link with that `value` (+0x37) or, if not, the second (+0x4b); none with the value: nothing. \n In the career, when the complaint passes (0x867240, 0x8674e0).

`database_get_club_assistant(club)`: the club's assistant (+0xd3); without one, that of the partner A/B team (0x540a50 with null and 1, which zeroes the club's flag +0x244 when it rejects the partner); none: 0. \n Null club: the original ("Error" box and 0). In the career, through the coach distribution (0x8b2880, in hirings and transfers), the regeneration (0x7a65d0) and the screens.

`database_get_club_coaches(club, array)`: the club's 5 coaches (+0x19f) into `array`. \n Without an A/B partner (0x540a50 with null and 1): the 5 slots as they are. With a partner: the club's non-null ones and then the partner's, up to 5; the rest zeroed only when the two together do not fill the 5. 8-bit counter in the original (at most 5). Returns 1. Null club: the original ("Error" box and 0). In the career, through the coach distribution (0x8b2880).

`database_count_club_coaches(club)`: how many of the club's 5 coaches (+0x19f) are valid people (not null, id (+0) < [0xae2364], signed) plus those of the partner A/B team (0x540a50 with null and 1, always called). \n Only `al` (the rest of eax is the partner's). Null club: the original ("Error" box and 0). In the career, through the regeneration queue (PLAYER_REGEN::process_regen_queue 0x7a65d0).

`nation_get_english_three_letter_name(nation)`: the nation's three-letter code, or its English one from eng.lng when another language is loaded. \n Language ([0x9b5984]) 0 or 1: its own code (+0x53). Otherwise the eng.lng table ([0xae2408]): nations in 109-byte rows from +0x2c, by id (without checking the count), the code at +0x4f of the row. SEH frame only on first use.

`stadium_get_english_name(stadium)`: the stadium's name, or its English one from eng.lng when another language is loaded. \n Language ([0x9b5984]) 0 or 1: its own name (+4). Otherwise the eng.lng table ([0xae2408]), 52-byte rows at [t+0x34], by id. SEH frame only on first use (new 0x40 and the load 0x544fc0), which stays with the original.

`eng_lng_free_tables(table)` (thiscall): `free` 0x9452ca on each of the 8 non-null rows, from +0x20 to +0x3c. \n The pointers stay; the callers, `load_database` 0x528503 and the language switch 0x533aa6, delete the table with `delete` 0x944c94 and zero [0xae2408].

`database_generate_extra_non_playing_staff()`: fills coaches, scouts and physios of the clubs of chosen nations by reputation and creates unattached managers for clubs without one. Called once at creation (by 0x524d70 at the start of the trims). 
 Checks the people with job 8 (box 0x62f on the first one outside the club's slots, and carries on). Then, in each club that is not a national team (id < [0xae235c] − 2 × [0xae2350]), is not a weak club of key 0x9cf2e4, has a chosen nation (+0x11c) and is not the A team of a pair (0x540a50 with 1): tops up coaches (+0x19f, 5, job 8), scouts (+0x1b3, 7, job 9) and physios (+0x1cf, 3, job 10) up to (reputation + 500) × slots / 10000, between 1 and the number of slots, with people from the reserve rows (make_extra_staff, nation +0x1a, +0x5f = 1, random birth date, names of the nation) placed in the first free slot. 
 Finally, each club without a manager (+0xcf) that is a national team or (with nation, division +0x57, chosen nation and reputation ≠ 0) or with reputation > 7500, except the weak ones of 0x9cf2e4, gets a manager (job 5, +0x28 = 5) with no club and no national team (he does not go into the slot). 
 Over 23,000: box (0x65f, 0x6aa, 0x6f5, 0x734) and 0. Writes "generated %ld extra non playing staff" to 0xde1f64 and returns 1. The pair local is only read when 0x540a50 returns a partner.

`database_trim_club_table(size)`: trims the club table by the database size. Called once at creation (create_game). Small = size 1 or 2. 
 Per nation (calloc of 0xd0 bytes per nation: 50 ids, count +0xc8, index of the lowest +0xcc), the clubs with the highest reputation (+0x80, signed 16 bits): up to 20 (15 in the small one); a nation not chosen (+0x11c) and outside the 15 nation keys: up to 5 (size 2) or 11 (size 1). Also kept: the clubs of people (+0x39, +0x24), those of the competition histories (+0xa, +0xe, +0x12, in range) and, outside the small one, those of the history of people with a chosen nation; the national teams; the club keys (0x60ba80 receives each id with the new row and returns 1 if it is a key); and those of chosen nations, except (in the small one) the weak ones of 0x9cf2e4. 
 Swaps the club pointers (club +0xb3/+0xb7/+0xbb, person +0x39/+0x24, preferences +4..+0x18, people history +0xa, competition history +0xa..+0x16) for the new ones (null for those removed), builds [0xae23fc] (new row → old id, malloc), compacts the table (id = new row), reallocs in place (another address: box 0x4ca and the end) and writes "Club table has %d entries" to 0xde1f64. 
 Without [0xae23a8] (box) or out of memory on new: the original; out of memory on the callocs: box and the end, as the original.

`database_prune_comp_history_table()`: called once at creation. Compacts the club competition history ([0xae23d4], [0xae237c] rows of 26 bytes): a row stays if it has a competition (+4) whose nation (+0x5d) is null or chosen (+0x11c), copied forward within the table itself. \n realloc (0x945667) to the new size, which becomes [0xae23d4] (without checking the address); [0xae237c] = rows; [0xae23dc] (the national teams part) = table + (rows − [0xae2384]) × 26; qsort (0x945333) with 0x540780.

`resolve_database_indexes(lenient)`: replaces every id field of the 12 tables with the record pointer (table + id × bytes). Called at load (load_database, with 0) and at save (save_database, after writing). \n In the original's order and with its rules: negative → null; some with a "greater than the count" ceiling (an id equal to the count passes), others "from the count on", others with no ceiling. Club: nation, divisions, stadiums, colours, people and clubs (+0x53..+0xbb, inclusive ceiling; a log line in 0xde1f64 for high nation, last division and stadium); squad +0xd7 (50; with `lenient` = 0, from [0xae2364] on it becomes null, with a log line above [0xae2364] + 0x52d), scouts, coaches, physios, directors, manager, chairman, assistant and the 20 selected (+0x1e0), with log lines. Then nations, referees, stadiums, preferences, non-players, people (player, preferences and non-player out of range: log line, box and null), person competitions, people history, cities, competition history and club competitions. \n Defects of the original, copied: the club's high last division (+0x5b) zeroes +0x60 (which later becomes competition 0) and stays raw; the high neighbouring stadium (+0x48) zeroes the city (+0x38) and stays raw. Does not read the target records nor allocate.

`database_sort_clubs_by_reputation(rebuild)`: called at creation, in load_game_data 0x82a9c0 (vector missing from the save) and in the daily loop 0x5cccd0. \n With `rebuild` (byte) ≠ 0, the vector [0xae2d1c] receives the ids (+0) of the [0xae235c] clubs in table order; then qsort (0x945333) of the [0xae235c] ids with 0x540020 (by reputation).

`database_free_staff_history_table()`: with the people history table ([0xae23cc], 17 bytes) present, frees it (0x9670f4, GlobalFree in the shared database, or 0x9452ca, free, by the database mode) and zeroes the pointer and the count [0xae2374]. \n TapeCall through PlayerStats::PlayerStats (0x7c0ccd): the history moves to `player stats history.tmp`. No stack frame.

`database_grow_comp_history_table(n)`: `realloc` 0x945667 of the competition history ([0xae23d4], 26 bytes) to [0xae237c] + `n` rows; out of memory returns 0 and nothing changes. \n Otherwise adds `n` to the count, stores the block, rebuilds the pointer to the national teams part [0xae23dc] (from row [0xae2384]) and clears the `n` new rows (+0 = the row's index, the rest zero); returns 1. TapeCall through comp_util_add_history_record (0x4afd2c), at the end of a competition. No stack frame.

qsort comparison of the club id vector (0x53db40) by reputation, highest first. \n By the reputation (+0x80, signed word) of the club ([0xae23b4] + id × 581; id −1 or lower = reputation 0): `a`'s lower than `b`'s: 1; higher: −1; equal: 0.

qsort comparison of squads (the trim of the joint A+B squad at 0x541e60 and the MLS all-star selections at 0x90a980): person pointers. \n A null person goes last (a null and b not: 1; a not and b null: −1; both: 0); then by the player's word +0xb (person +0x61; no player, 0), highest first (b − a).

qsort comparison of the squad in the team strength (club_squad_strength_band 0x549a30): person pointers. \n No person or no player record (+0x61) in `a`: 1 (even if `b` is the same); in `b`: −1; then by current ability (player +5, signed word) and, when tied, by the word +0xb, highest first (b − a).

`staff_normalise_player_physical_attributes(person)`: lowers the physical attributes above the current ability and rebalances the attribute vector. \n With the player record (person +0x61): removes the training progress (0x8b3640); cut = (ability +5 / 2 − ftol(weighted sum of the physical attributes × [0x969528]) + 0x37) / 2, the sum with the .rdata constants (+0x36, +0x2f, +0x2e, +0x1b, +0x3f, +0x40, the lower of +0x3b/+0x30, plus +0x44); cut < −14: adds max(cut / 15, −2) to +0x1b, +0x36, +0x40 and +0x44 (at least 1); target = cut − 20 − min((+0x36 × +0x1b) / 2 − ability, 25) when it exceeds the ability, clamped to −40..0; vector (0xff81/0x81) through 0x53a610, `rebalance_attr_vector` without cells 0x18 and 0x1e (0x11/0x12 count double), back through 0x53aa10; player +0xf = 20: removes the averages of +0x2a/+0x3a and the third of +0x1e, +0x24, +0x39 (pair and trio averages); restores the training progress.

A second name (60-byte row in [0xae23f4]) by weight. \n A nation with more than 10 second names (`nation_name_index` +0x1c): 3 draws in its range (from +4), the one with the highest weight is kept (+0x3b, signed; starts at −1, and row 0 if none passes). No nation or up to 10: a draw over the whole table ([0xae239c], at most 0x7fff). Only the CRT rand(). TapeCall through OfficialsManager::add_random_officials (0x79c6b4), when creating the referees of a new game.

`staff_normalise_player_attributes(person)`: rebalances the player's attribute vector with target −20. \n With the player record (person +0x61): removes the training progress (0x8b3640), builds the vector through 0x53a610 (without pre-filling: the cells used all come from it), `rebalance_attr_vector` with target −20 in all cells of the range (12 cells within the limit, excess above 85 spread; 0x11/0x12 count ftol(value × [0x968f98])), back through 0x53aa10; player +0xf ≥ 15: removes the averages of +0x2a/+0x3a; restores the training progress. \n Runs at creation (after 0x538ec0), at load and in training.

`club_get_english_short_name(club)`: the club's short name, or its English one from eng.lng when another language is loaded. \n Language ([0x9b5984]) 0 or 1: its own short name (+0x38). Otherwise the eng.lng table ([0xae2408], 79-byte rows from +0x20, the short name at +0x34 of the row): through the id map [0xae23fc] if present, otherwise by id if < the count (+0), otherwise 0.

`database_trim_senior_and_b_team_squads()`: flags every club that has a partner team and trims each joint senior+B squad to 48. Called once at creation (create_game 0x8282f1). \n In each club, the flag +0x244 = has a partner (0x540a50 with 0) and the partner has a nation (+0x53). In the A team (`is_a`): the joint A+B squad (0x541f90 with double: 100 pointers) in reputation order (qsort 0x945333 with 0x5402f0); from the back to the front, while the joint squad has more than 48, removes the person from her club (0x53c190 with the club +0x39, no date, detaching the person, not as a player), skipping the goalkeepers (player +0x61 with +0xf ≥ 15, signed byte) while 3 or fewer remain. \n Signed 8-bit counters, like the original's. No draw; the local `is_a` is only read when 0x540a50 returns a partner (and then it was written).

`database_merge_b_team_staff()`: for every senior team with a B team, trims the B squad and moves the B backroom staff to the senior club. Called once at creation (create_game 0x8283d9). \n For each A team with a B partner (0x540a50 with 1, which requires the +0x244 flag from 0x541e60): counts the valid people (non-null pointer and id < [0xae2364]) of the A squad (+0xd7, 50), sorts the B squad (qsort with 0x540130) and removes from B those beyond 50 in the joint total. \n Then, in slots +0x19f (5, job 8), +0x1b3 (7, job 9) and +0x1cf (3, job 10): each valid person of B leaves it (0x53c190) and, while A has room, joins A (0x53bd10 with the game date 0xae2c90, writing into the person). Manager (+0xcf): with both, B's just leaves; only B's: leaves and joins A with his job (+0x3d, read after leaving; the original pushes the byte with garbage above it, and 0x53bd10 uses only the byte), no date. Assistant (+0xd3): with both, B's leaves. No draw.

`database_build_nation_name_index()`: allocates and builds the per-nation index of the first, second and common name tables. Called at creation (create_game 0x82836c) and when loading the game. \n Allocates (malloc 0x944e46) [0xae2350] entries of 0x24 bytes in [0xae2338]: first row (+0, +4, +8 = −1), weight total (+0xc, +0x10, +0x14 = 0) and count (+0x18, +0x1c, +0x20 = 0) of the first, second and common names. Walks the second names ([0xae23f4], [0xae239c]), the first names ([0xae23f0], [0xae2398]) and the common names ([0xae23f8], [0xae23a0]), 60-byte rows with the nation at +0x37 (0..[0xae2350]) and the weight at +0x3b (signed byte): consecutive rows of the same nation form a group, written into the entry of the nation's id (+0) when the nation changes. \n Defect of the original, copied: the last group of each table is not written. Out of memory: the original.

`database_remove_staff_from_club(club, person, date, detach, as_player)`: removes the person from the club slot her job points to; 0 if she was not in the slot. Called at creation (the trims of 0x541e60, 0x544970 and 0x524d70) and in the career (transfers, sackings). 
 National team = club id ≥ [0xae235c] − 2 × [0xae2350]. With `date`: its 8 bytes go into the person (+0x29 for a national team, otherwise +0x3e; 0x417c10 copies +2, +0 and +4 and repeats into a local nobody reads), before looking at the job. Job = person +0x28 (national team) or +0x3d (byte); with `as_player`, 11, 12, 13 and 15 become 11 and the others 0. 
 Slots (jump table 0x53c54c): 0 none; 1 +0xbf; 2..4 +0xc3 (3); 5 +0xcf and, for the senior national team (id < [0xae235c] − [0xae2350]), the under-21 side's +0xcf (0x53b4f0 with the nation +0x53) if it is the same person; 6, 7 +0xd3; 8 +0x19f (5); 9 +0x1b3 (7); 10 +0x1cf (3); 11 squad +0xd7 (50); 12 +0xcf and the squad; 13 +0xd3 and the squad; 15 +0x19f and the squad; 14, above 15 or negative: 0. 
 The slot that has the person (the first) is zeroed; person not in the slot: 0 (in 12, 13 and 15 the first slot, already zeroed, stays so). With `detach`: clears the club in the person (+0x24 for a national team, +0x39 for a club). Returns 1. Null club: 0. Null person: the original ("Error" box and 0).

`database_get_club_scouts(club, array)`: the 7 scouts (+0x1b3) of `club` into `array`. \n Without an A/B partner (0x540a50 with null and 1, which zeroes the club's flag +0x244 when it rejects the partner): the 7 slots as they are. With a partner: the club's non-null ones and then the partner's, up to 7; the rest zeroed only when the two together do not fill the 7. 8-bit counter in the original (at most 7). Returns 1. Null club: the original ("Error" box and 0). In the career, through 0x7f7270 (the scouts' lists, in transfers and hirings).

A first name (60-byte row in [0xae23f0]) by weight. \n A nation with more than 15 first names (`nation_name_index` +0x18): 3 draws in its range, the one with the highest weight is kept (+0x3b, signed; starts at −1, and row 0 if none passes). No nation or up to 15: a draw over the whole table ([0xae2398], at most 0x7fff). Only the CRT rand().

The colours of `competition` in pixels (0x5e4800 with bytes +0x37, +0x38, +0x39 of the colour and format 0): `foreground` and `background`, which start with [0xae3184] and [0xaebe04]. \n The colours come from the +0x5d record (its +0x90 and +0x94) or, without it, from the competition itself (+0x61 and +0x65); a null colour leaves the default. Returns 1. Null competition: the original (defaults, "Error" box and 0).

1 if `club` has room for `person` in `job` (signed byte, jump table 0x53bcc8): an empty slot or one already theirs. \n 1 +0xbf; 2..4 +0xc3 (3); 5 +0xcf; 6, 7 +0xd3; 8 +0x19f (5); 9 +0x1b3 (7); 10 +0x1cf (3); 11 squad +0xd7 (50); 12 and 13: +0xcf / +0xd3 free or hers and room in the squad; 15: room in +0x19f and in the squad. Null club or person, job 14 or outside 1..15: the original (error box and 0).

Puts `person` at `club` in `job` (byte, jump table 0x53c14c), copies the date and writes club and job into the person. 
 A person in the humans' range (id ≥ [0xae2364] − 16) only in job 5. With `date`: its 8 bytes go into the person (+0x29 if the club is a national team, id ≥ [0xae235c] − 2 × [0xae2350]; otherwise +0x3e; 0x417c10 copies +2, +0 and +4 and repeats into a local nobody reads). With `reduce`: jobs 11, 12, 13 and 15 become 11, the others 0. A player (+0x61) with current ability (+5) > 85 at a club without a human manager (0x600a50 with 0, 1, 0, 0): 6 becomes 13 and 8 becomes 15. 
 Slots: 1 +0xbf; 2..4 +0xc3 (3); 5 +0xcf; 6, 7 +0xd3; 8 +0x19f (5); 9 +0x1b3 (7); 10 +0x1cf (3); 11 squad +0xd7 (50); 12 +0xcf and the squad (no room in the squad: 0 with +0xcf already written); 13 +0xd3 and the squad (no room in the squad, stays 6); 15 +0x19f and the squad (no room in the squad, stays 8); 0 none; 14 and outside: 0. 
 With `write`: club and job into the person (+0x24/+0x28 national team, +0x39/+0x3d club). Returns 1. Null club or person: the original ("Error" box and 0).

How many valid people are in the squad of `club` (byte). \n With an A/B partner (0x540a50 with 1): `mode` 2 and an A club counts only the partner; otherwise counts the club and, except for `mode` 1 with a B club, also the partner. Without a partner and with a reserve team (0x542740): only the people with the `mode` bits in the squad flags (+0x5e), if `mode` is not 0. \n With `filter`, someone who has a loan contract record (0x4cf6d0) and a club (+0x39) other than `club` only counts if the contract's club (0x4cf5a0, stored in [0xae1080]; +4 = id) is also another one (the loanee filter). Null club: the original (error box).

Copies the squad of `club` (50 pointers at +0xd7) into `array`. \n Without an A/B partner (0x540a50 with null and 1): the 50 as they are and, with `double`, 50 more zeros. With a partner: only the valid people of the club and then those of the partner, up to the limit (100 with `double`, otherwise 50), the rest up to the limit zeroed. Returns 1. Null club: the original (error box and 0).

Whether `club` can be managed. Needs a nation (+0x53). \n National teams (id ≥ [0xae235c] − 2 × [0xae2350], signed): only the senior ones (id < [0xae235c] − [0xae2350]) of a nation with +0x88 > 150. Clubs: with a competition (+0x57), not the B team of a pair (0x540a50 with 1), with the competition in the vector [[0xadadfc] + id × 4] (active) and the nation with bit 2 of +0x11c (flagged).

The inverse of 0x53a8b0: the low byte of each of the 21 three-byte cells of `vector` goes back to `non_player` (the coaching attributes +0x0e..+0x22) in the order `NON_PLAYER_ATTRIBUTE_ORDER`. \n The person is not used. eax on exit: the vector with the last copied byte in the low byte (callers do not use it).

The inverse of 0x53a610: the low byte of cells 0..53 of `vector` goes back to `player` at the offsets of `ATTRIBUTE_VECTOR_CELLS`, and that of cell 54 to `person` +0x58. \n eax on exit: the vector with the last byte in the low byte (callers do not use it).

Rebalances the attributes of the non-player (person +0x69) in two passes. \n Builds the vector (63 cells 0xff81/0x81, filled by 0x53a8b0, which returns the cut 13) and, twice, starting from the cut: (1) with limit 40, +10 per round, up to 6 cells with |value| ≤ limit (marked); cell 19 outside the limit is also marked; (2) adds −5 − mean to the marked ones (clamped to −125..125), pulling the mean of the near-zero cells to −5; in the 1st pass the unmarked positive ones go into the excess sum, the others are marked; with job +0x3d or +0x28 = 10, the cells stay ≤ −80 and cell 19 ≥ 0; (3) in the 1st pass, with sum > 28, takes (sum − 28) / count off the unmarked ones (minimum 0). \n At the end, 0x53a980 writes back. Null person or non-player: nothing.

The coaching `attribute` (1..12) of `person`, from her `non_player` record (+0x69). \n Direct: 1 person +0x56, 4 person +0x58, 7 non-player +0x14, 12 +0x22. The others (2 +0x11, 3 +0x10, 5 +0x17, 6 +0x18, 8 +0x19, 9 +0x1b, 10 +0x1e, 11 +0x21) through the 1-to-20 formula of 0x544410: x = (word +4 + 2 × byte) × 0.05 + 10; (x + 0.1 x²) / 3 + 0.5, clamped to 1..20 and truncated. \n Null person or non-player, or attribute outside 1..12: the original (error box and −1).

A first name (60-byte row in [0xae23f0]) for `nation`. \n No nation: a draw over the whole table. A nation with more than 100 first names: 20 draws in its range, the one with the highest weight (+0x3b, signed) among the accepted ones (`is_acceptable_name`) is kept. With up to 100: language group 0 draws over the whole table, but returns the row of the SECOND names table ([0xae23f4], as in the original); otherwise borrows from `name_donor_nation` (the language group). Only the CRT rand() (not 0x90cfc0).

Writes the name of `person` into `dest` in `style` (byte, 1..7), with first name (+4), surname (+8) and common name (+0xc, or the nickname given by the human: 0x600740/0x6005e0 on [0xb63c98]). \n 1 "first surname", 2 "F.surname", 3 "surname, first", 4 "surname, F", 5 a single name, 6 initials, 7 like 1 without preferring the common name; always with fallbacks (whatever there is). Returns 1. \n Null person or destination, size (i16) < 0x69 or style outside 1..7: the original (error box and 0).

The colours of `kit` (byte: 1 home +0x83/+0x87, 2 away +0x8b/+0x8f, 3 third +0x93/+0x97; 2 and 3 with one of the two colours missing: the home ones swapped) of `club` as screen pixels (0x5e4800 with bytes +0x37, +0x38, +0x39 of the colour and format 0): `foreground` and `background`, which start with [0xaebdf0] and [0xae3184]. \n Any other kit: only the defaults. Returns 1. Null club: the original (defaults, "Error" box and 0).

The manager (+0xcf) of `club`; without one, that of the A/B partner (0x540a50 with 0 and 1); without either, an ordinary club gives 0 and a national team (id ≥ [0xae235c] − [0xae2350]) repeats with its nation's national team (0x53b3d0 with +0x53: the under-21 side reaches the senior one). \n Null club (at the start or coming from 0x53b3d0): the original with null ("Error" box and 0).

The name of `club` in English: its own name, or its English one from eng.lng when another language is loaded. \n Language ([0x9b5984]) 0 or 1: its own name (+4). Otherwise the eng.lng table ([0xae2408], 79-byte rows from +0x20): through the id map [0xae23fc] if present, otherwise by id if < the count (+0), otherwise 0.

Adds `delta` (signed byte) to the morale (+0x45) of the player record (person +0x61), damped near the ends; returns whether it changed. \n Going up above 10, if random(21) < morale + delta, adds only random(delta + 1); going down below 10, if random((player +0x2f + person +0x5a + person +0x58) / 3) > morale + delta, adds random(delta − 1). Clamps to 1..20 (signed byte); with `limit` and delta > 0, the link with the club (0x4cf5f0, person +0x39) with +0x45 not null prevents going up. Returns 1 if the morale changed. Delta 0: 0, without reading anything.

Widens (movsx) the attributes of `non_player` (coaching attributes +0x0e..+0x22) into the low 16 bits of the 21 three-byte cells of `vector` (the 3rd byte of each stays as it is) and writes 13 (the split) into `end` if not null. \n The person is not used. eax on exit: the high 16 bits of the non-player pointer and the last widened attribute (callers do not use it).

Sets `squad` (byte) in the person's squad flags (+0x5e): with club bits (& 3) keeps the national team ones (& 0xc), otherwise keeps the club ones; then adds. \n The original writes twice (the mask and the result). Returns the person (eax).

qsort comparison of the competition history rows. \n A row without a competition (+4) goes last (a without and b with: 1; a with and b without: −1; both without: 0); then by the competition id (a − b); within the same one, by season (+8, word) from newest to oldest (b − a), unless one of them is −1 (0).

Widens the bytes of the `player` record into a vector of 63 three-byte cells (signed word + weight). \n Zeroes the 63 weights; cells 0..53 by the table `ATTRIBUTE_VECTOR_CELLS` (positions 0..8, sides 9..11, then the attributes, weight 2 on those that count and 1 on +0x2a); cell 54 is byte +0x58 of `person`. The group ends go to the non-null outputs: positions 9, sides 0xc, weighted 0x20. Returns the vector (eax).

1 if the link (0x4cf5f0) of `person` with `club` is transfer listed at request (link +0x4e, bit 8). \n Without a club, the contract's club (0x4cf5a0, stored in [0xae1080]; contract +4 = id in table [0xae23b4], 581 bytes per club).

1 if `club` may have a reserve side. \n Not: national teams (id ≥ [0xae235c] − [0xae2350]), clubs with an A/B partner (0x540a50 with null and 1); in the range of the second national sides (id ≥ [0xae235c] − 2 × [0xae2350]), nation Spain, Norway, [0x9cf360], Brazil or Argentina, or continent (+0x71) [0x9cfa18] or [0x9cfa08]; in the others, nation Spain, Germany or Portugal. Null club: "Error" box and 0 (the original).

How far `viewer` stands from `person`, which picks the reputation. \n 0 = same club or clubs of the same nation (+0x39, club +0x53) → the home one; 2 = same nation (+0x1a) or not foreign in it (0x53d980) → the current one; 3 = not foreign in the nation of the person's club, or player reputation (+0x61, +9) + reputation of the viewer's club (+0x80) ≥ 14000 → the average; 4 (no viewer, viewer among the last 16 ids = human managers, no data or no club) → the world one. \n Only al is returned (callers use al).

The reputation of `person` as seen by `viewer`, by the scope (0x5408c0): from the player data (+0x61: current +9, home +0xb, world +0xd) or, with `non_player`, from the non-player data (+0x69: +8, +0xa, +0xc). \n 4 → world, 2 → current, 0 → home, 3 → half the world + half the current, other → half the home + half the current (truncating divisions). Only ax is returned.

1 if `person` is foreign in `nation` (null: 1). \n Not foreign with the nation as first (+0x1a) or second nationality (+0x1e). With `groups`, also not foreign: among England, Scotland, Wales, Northern Ireland and Ireland (British Isles); between Australia and [0x9cf3f4]; in [0x9cf360] with the nation [0x9cf4f0]; and in Portugal someone who is not from the EU (0x53d740) with a contract (0x4cf5a0) that started up to 1/1/1998 (Date 0x549f70; contract +0x25 day, +0x27 year).

The age of `person` in whole years on `date` (word +0 day of year, +2 year): year − birth year (+0x12), minus 1 if the birth day (+0x10) has not come yet. \n Null person: "Error" box and 0xff (the original). Only ax is returned (callers use al).

1 if `person` counts as an EU national for a club of `club_nation`. \n Nationality (+0x1a) or second nationality (+0x1e) with the EU mark (nation +0x7f = 2) or Switzerland ([0x9cf4ac]); in Germany, any European (nation +0x71 = the continent [0x9cfa10] in table [0xae23a4], 198 bytes); in [0x9cf360], everyone; in Denmark, [0x9cf348], Norway and [0x9cf3a0].

1 if the link (0x4cf5f0) of `person` with `club` is transfer listed, by the club or at request (link +0x4e, bits 1 and 8). \n Without a club, the contract's club (0x4cf5a0, stored in [0xae1080]; contract +4 = club id in table [0xae23b4], 581 bytes per club).

The player `attribute` (1..31) as 1 to 20. \n Some are the byte of the `player` record; the relative ones give the rating (`attribute_rating`) of 2 × byte + current ability (+5), or of 2 × byte + ability × 0.1 depending on the goalkeeper (+0xf: = 20 or < 15); 10 is byte +0x58 of `person`; some go to 0x544380 (or 0x5442f0). No person, no player or attribute out of range: "Error" box and 0xff (the original). Only al is returned.

`save_database_for_game(save, a4, type)`: step 1 of `save_game_data`: `save_database(save, 1, a4, type)` (0x52dad0, into the container), the database tables, returning its result. \n TURNED OFF (DESLIGADAS in motor.rs): save_database writes into index.dat 408 bytes of unset locals (pointer garbage, from +0x5cb); called from this copy it runs on the private stack and the garbage written changes (proof of the save of the 219th batch). It comes back when the copy reproduces the residue.

`Staff_Records::add_league_champions_record(club, comp)`: records the league champion. SEH frame only for the local dates. Called by the league champions at the end of each league (25 callers, one per league; 4 calls up to 2002-06-01). 
 Null club or competition: the error box (line 0x21c); the competition without an object in [0xadadfc] (+ 4 × id): the error box (0x224). The reputation (up to weight × 500, +750 at most); with +0x57 and the club's +0x69 block: +0x7b goes up weight × 20 (below 150000 and below +0x73 + 500) and the block's +0x44 by 25 × (weight + 20) (below 120000). The players' threshold: ftol((+0x3e − 1) × the object's +0x3c × 0.33), in 16 bits. 
 With a manager (+0xcf): his three ratings (+0xa weight × 400, +8 weight × k1, +0xc weight × k2 in the +0x69 record, if any) and the history (type 5: the club and the competition); his record (0x86f5b0 with create): +1 in +0x8c and weight × 5000 in +0xb6, +0xca and +0xba. The chairman (+0xbf). 
 The 50 in the squad (+0xd7) with a player sheet, valid, of the club (+0x39) and other than the manager: the average 2/1 (0x7c1e30 with 6.5) above the threshold gives the history, morale +20 (0x544710) and +100 on the contract (0x4cf5f0) with the renewal; otherwise morale +10 and +50 on the contract. The club's history (type 5); with the media ([0xb6b7c8]) and weight above 3, the praise (0x75c390 with 1) and, above 12, with 3.

`Staff_Records::add_cup_winners_record(club, fixture, match)`: records the cup winner. SEH frame only for the local dates. Called by the cup finals (29 callers; 11 calls up to 2002-06-01). \n Nulls: the error box (line 0x51e). The reputation (as in the league); with a manager (+0xcf) who has a non-player record (+0x69): the three ratings of the club's side in the match (+0x188/+0x18a/+0x18c, side 0x625 × away; weight × 400, × k1, × k2); the manager's history (type 0: the club and the competition of the fixture's +0x14); his record (0x86f5b0 with create): +1 in +0x8a and ftol(weight^4 × 0.5) (CRT pow 0x945ff0) in +0xb6, +0xca and, for a national team (0x53b900), +0xbe, otherwise +0xba. The chairman (+0xbf) and the 20 of the line-up. \n The 50 in the squad while the reputation does not exceed weight × 400: with a player sheet, valid and other than the manager, morale +15 (0x544710) and +100 on the contract; with contract status (+0x4f >> 4) 1-3 or 5, the renewal. The call-ups of the stored competition (0x76d940) end (0x774f30); the club's history (type 0); with the media and weight above 10, the praise (0x75c390 with 1) and, with weight above 12 or reputation below 2500, with 3.

`Staff_Records::clear_human_manager_record(person)`: clears a human manager's record. Called by the human manager's retirement (0x6b2b40) and by setup (0x82b9xx). \n A person among the 16 humans (id from [0xae2364] − 16 to [0xae2364]): his record in vector +8 (slot id − [0xae2364] + [0xae2368] + 16, 0xd2 bytes); otherwise, as in the original, the person itself. Zeroes the 0xd2 bytes and puts −1 in +0x86, +0xc2, +0xc6, +0x4a, +0x5e and +0x72.

`Staff_Records::record_match_result(fixture, match)`: records a match in both managers' records. Called by the closing of the day's match (0x6b5f00), for each game. \n Match not played (+0x3a = 1): nothing. The records of the two managers (+0xcf of the home side +0x1c and of the away side +0x20; 0x86f5b0 with create): +1 game (+0x8e); goals for (+0x96) and against (+0x9a) from the score (+0x47/+0x48, or +0x43/+0x44 with +0x47 = −1); win (+0x90, bonus 900), draw (+0x92, 300 for both) or loss (+0x94). Each one's rating (0x48e190 with 0 / 1, the opponent's reputation, the match points at +0x11f.. / +0x744..; importance × opponent reputation × weight × points) goes to +0xb6 and +0xca (month and year); in the club's league (+0x57 or +0x60 = the competition +0x14) also to the month's points (+0xce); for a national team (0x53b900) to +0xbe, otherwise +0xba (season). \n Defect of the original, reproduced: for the away manager, +0xbe/+0xba receive the routine's [esp+0x10], which is the home manager's rating (or his bonus, without a record).

`Staff_Records::add_league_finish_records(league)`: at the end of the league, each club's final position in its manager's history. SEH frame only for the local date. Called by the completed league (0x689ad0). \n For each row of the table (0x6826d0, up to +0x3e), the history of the club's manager (+0xcf; type 0xa: the club id, the competition of +4, the year +0x3a and the position k + 1), in the archive (0x58e340).

`Staff_Records::add_supporters_player_of_year_record(person, club, a, b)`: the supporters' player of the year. SEH frame only for the local date. Called by the end of season of the records (0x447880). \n The person's history (type 0x35: the club id, `a` as unsigned 16 bits and `b`), in the archive (0x58e340); then, if draw(21 − the person's +0x59) < draw(10), the person likes the club (0x547d90 with draw(2)) and the club likes him (0x547870 with draw(2)). Null person: the original (the error box and the read of the null person's +0x59).

`Staff_Records::record_manager_job_change(manager, club, hired)`: closes the manager's current spell, opens the new one when hired and counts the spells. SEH frame only for the local dates. Called by the manager's departure (0x69b790) and by the new manager (0x694c80). \n Outside a national team (0x53b900), in the manager's record (0x86f5b0 with create), when the game start ([0xdd6ec8]) is not after today: the current spell (+0x4a club, +0x4e start) closes; the shortest (+0x72, +0x76 start, +0x7e end) is replaced by the current one if there is none or if the current one is shorter (0x54cdb0), or only has its end renewed if it is the same; the longest (+0x5e, +0x62, +0x6a) is replaced if the current one is longer (the end becomes +0x56) or if there is none (the end becomes today). Then +0x4a = −1 and, with hired = 1, the new spell (the club id, today, +0x56 = 13/11/1975 from 0x549f70) and +1 in +0xb4. For a national team, hired = 1: +1 in +0xb5. \n The histories: the manager's (type 0x96: club, hired), the club chairman's (+0xbf; type 0x97 with the manager and the three keys) and the club's (type 0x96 in +8, the manager, the keys and hired). Null manager or club: the error box (line 0x3b1).

`Staff_Records::add_team_of_year_record(person, club, award, a, b)`: the team of the year entry in the person's history. SEH frame only for the local date, with an empty destructor. Called by TEAM_AWARD::record_winners 0x8affb0. \n Null person or award: the "Error" box (line 0x7ee). Otherwise the person's history (type 0x32: the club id or −1, the award id, `a` as unsigned 16 bits and `b` as a signed byte), in the archive (0x58e340).

`staff_records_compare_clubs_by_manager_points(a, b)`: the qsort order of the manager of the year candidates (0x86fab0): orders two clubs by their manager's league season points, highest first. \n The records of the two clubs' managers (club_manager_record_global); neither, 0; only `a`'s missing, 1; only `b`'s missing, −1; with both, `b`'s league season points (+0xba) minus `a`'s (more points first).

`Staff_Records::add_promotion_record(club, comp, weight)`: records a promotion. SEH frame without a destructor. \n The club's reputation (+0x80) goes up 500 (up to 10000) and +0x7b goes up 10 × the competition's importance (+0x69) if it is below 150000 and below +0x73 + 500. The manager (+0xcf) with a non-player record: ratings +0xa, +8 and +0xc go up by the competition's importance (that of its club competition record +0x1c, if any) × 400, × 200/400 (foreigner in the league with +0x42 = 1, 0x53d980) and × 200/400 (league with +0x42 = 1) × 10/61, with a minimum of importance × weight. \n The manager's and chairman's history (type 8), the manager's points (0x86f5b0: +0xb6, +0xba, +0xca add importance × weight × 25), morale +15 for each squad player (0x544710), the contract bond (+0x44) +75 (−100..100) and the renewal (0x4cda70) of the expiring contracts of types 1, 2, 3 and 5; finally the club's history (type 8). Null club or competition: the "Error" box (line 0x301).

`Staff_Records::add_relegation_record(club, comp)`: records a relegation. SEH frame without a destructor. \n The club's reputation (+0x80) drops 500 (minimum 750). The manager with a non-player record: ratings +0xa (−16), +8 (−8 if a foreigner, 0x53d980, or −16) and +0xc (−8) × the competition's importance (+0x69), clamped to 1..10000; the manager's and chairman's history (type 9). Each squad player: morale −15 (0x544710) and, by contract type (+0x4f >> 4): 1 and 2, reputations × 0.9 and the renewal (0x4cda70) if expiring; 3 to 5, reputations × 0.95. Finally the club's history (type 9). Null club or competition: the "Error" box (line 0x476).

`Staff_Records::add_qualified_for_round_record(club, comp, stage, round, weight)`: SEH frame without a destructor. \n With a manager (+0xcf), his history (type 3: club, competition or −1, the signed stage and the base round 0x4b0870) and the points (0x86f5b0): importance² × weight added to +0xb6 (year), +0xca (month) and, for a national team (0x53b900), +0xbe (cup), or for a club +0xba (league). Null club: the "Error" box (line 0x703).

`Staff_Records::add_transfer_records(transfer)`: updates the buying and selling managers' records and the transfer histories. SEH frame without a destructor. \n The person's contract (0x4cf5a0) goes to [0xae1080] and gives the seller (outside state 5); the offer's total value (0x8e7a70 with 1, 0, 0, 1). The buyer's manager, when the offer type is for a player (+0x11, 0x53b620): in the record (0x86f5b0) the biggest signing (+0..+0x24 if the value exceeds +0x18), the signings (+0xa0), the spending (+0xa4, 64 bits), the players given in exchange (+0xa2) and their value (+0x52 of each, in +0xac). The seller's manager, when the person's job is player (+0x3d): the biggest sale (+0x25..+0x49 if it exceeds +0x3d), the sales (+0xa2), the income (+0xac), the players received (+0xa0) and their value (+0xa4). \n The histories (types 0x64 buy, 0x65 sale, 0x66 transfer) of the buyer's manager, the seller's manager, the person and the exchange players, in the archive (0x58e340).

`Staff_Records::add_knocked_out_record(club, comp, stage, round, _)`: SEH frame without a destructor. \n The manager's history (+0xcf; type 4: club, competition or −1, the signed stage and the base round 0x4b0870) and the end of the national team's call-ups in the stored competition. Null club: the "Error" box (line 0x73b).

`Staff_Records::add_failed_to_qualify_record(club, comp, stage, _)`: SEH frame without a destructor. \n The manager's history (type 7: club, competition or −1, the signed stage) and the end of the national team's call-ups in the stored competition. Null club: the "Error" box (line 0x768).

`Staff_Records::daily_update(date)`: if the date's month (0x54cfb0) or year (+2) are not the stored ones (+0x14 month, +0x16 year), zeroes the month's points (+0xca, +0xce) of every record and stores the new month and year. \n On the first day of the year (day +0 = 0) passes the year's points (+0xb6) of each record with a person (+0x86) to the hall of fame (0x5ef270 on [0xb5ded8]) and zeroes them.

`Staff_Records::end_season_for_nation(entry)`: at the end of the competition's season passes its managers' league and cup points to the hall of fame and clears them. \n With the entry's competition (+0, id at its +0; no competition −1; no competition and +4 not equal to [0x9cfa10], nothing), for each record: league (+0xc2) of the competition: adds the cup (+0xbe) if it also belongs to that competition (+0xc6 = −1, +0xbe = 0), passes the points (+0xba) to the hall of fame (0x5ef330) if the competition keeps them (+0x11c), zeroes them and +0xc2 = −1; only the competition's cup: passes +0xbe, zeroes it and +0xc6 = −1.

`Staff_Records::find_manager_of_the_month(index)`: the league manager with the most points this month. \n In the league ([0xadadfc] by the index; +0x43 must be 2, otherwise the "Error" box and 0), among the clubs of the table (+0xb1, 0x3b bytes, count +0x3e) with a manager (+0xcf) at the club (+0x39) since two weeks ago (0x54cab0 of the game date; year +0x40 unsigned, day +0x3e signed), the one with the most points in the month (+0xce of the record 0x86f5b0, created if missing), only above 0. Returns the manager or 0.

`Staff_Records::get_manager_of_year_candidates(clubs, n)` (called by 0x768940; SEH frame without an object with a destructor): sorts the clubs and keeps up to three. \n The qsort of the `n` clubs (0x870220) and, in order, up to three whose manager (+0xcf) arrived (+0x3e) before today − 28 weeks (0x54cab0; year unsigned, day signed) and has a record (0x86f5b0 with 1) with games (+0x8e), copied to the start of the vector itself. Returns how many.

`Staff_Records::get_manager_record(person, create)`: finds (or creates, or takes over) the manager's 210-byte record (vector +8). \n Null person: the error box at line 0xf6e and 0. Free slot (+0x86 = −1): without `create`, 0; with it, the slot takes the id. Someone else's slot: zeroes the record of that person (−1 in +0x86, +0xc2, +0xc6, +0x4a, +0x5e, +0x72) and looks again. \n Updates the nations of the club (+0x39) and of the national team (+0x24) in +0xc2/+0xc6, zeroing the points (+0xba/+0xbe) when they change. With the date of [0xdd6ec8] up to today: no spell (+0x4a = −1), opens the current club's one (since the person's +0x3e; +0x56 = the date 13/11/1975 from 0x549f70); the longest (+0x5e, +0x62..+0x6a) and the shortest (+0x72, +0x76..+0x7e) through 0x54cdb0, today's in +0x6a / +0x7e. Returns the record.

`Staff_Records::add_free_release_records(person)`: the free release histories. SEH frame only for the local date, with an empty destructor. \n The person's contract (0x4cf5a0) goes to [0xae1080] and gives the club (0x245-byte record through +4). With a manager at the club (+0xcf), his history (type 0x68: the club, the person and her three ids +0x33 of +4, +8 and +0xc); then the person's (type 0x67: the club or −1), in the archive (0x58e340). Null person: the "Error" box (line 0x1010).

`Staff_Records::add_loan_records(person, from, club)` (called by 0x8c2180, the accepted transfer): the loan histories. SEH frame only for the local date, with an empty destructor. \n With the club and its manager (+0xcf), the manager's history (type 0x69: the club, the person and her three ids +0x33 of +4, +8 and +0xc, and the id of `from`); then, in the same entry, the person's (type 0x6a: the club and the id of `from`), in the archive (0x58e340). The club is read before the person check, as in the original; null person: the "Error" box (line 0x1010).

`Staff_Records::rewind_staff_history(person)`: the person's history list (the 8-byte pair at [+0xc] + 8 × id) drops the last entry (0x58f110 on [this]: the second offset, +4 of the pair, = −1). \n Null person: the original (fatal box: the game ends).

`Staff_Records::add_year_award_record(p, club, award, a4, a5, credit)`: records a year award. SEH frame without a destructor. Called by the recording of the year award winners (YEAR_AWARD::record_winners 0x9302f0: the first, the second and the third). \n Entry 0x34 of the person's history (game date, club or −1, the award id, a4 in the word, a5 and the credit as signed bytes; 0x58e340). Manager (+0x3d or +0x28 = 5 or 0xc): +1 in the word +0x9e of his record (0x86f5b0). \n A player with a player sheet (+0x61) and a contract (0x4cf5a0, other than type 5) with the club (0x4cf5f0): with the transfer manager, a contract of more than 300 days and the player on the club's list (0x849ce0), the renewal (0x4cda70); then, only with credit 1, without the contract's +0x45 flag, with +0x59 above 15 and +0x5b above 10, if draw(+0x59) is above 5 (a draw by loyalty): the news of thanks to the manager (0x58a070). No person or no award: the original ("Error" box).

`Staff_Records::add_first_cap_record(person, opponent)` (called by the international result 0x76b600): the first cap history. SEH frame only for the local date, with an empty destructor. \n The person's history (type 6: the contracting club +0x39 or −1, the opponent's id in the match and the age +0x18, signed), in the archive (0x58e340). The club is read before the person check, as in the original; null person: the "Error" box (line 0x1010).

`Staff_Records::add_month_award_record(p, club, award, a4, a5)`: writes the winner's 0x33 history entry. SEH frame without a destructor. \n Entry 0x33 of the person's history (game date, club or −1, the award id, a4 in the byte, a5 in the word; 0x58e340). Manager (+0x3d or +0x28 = 5 or 0xc): +1 in the word +0x9e of his record (0x86f5b0). \n A player with a player sheet (+0x61) and a contract (0x4cf5a0, other than type 5) with the club (0x4cf5f0): with the transfer manager, a contract of more than 300 days and the player on the club's list (0x849ce0), the renewal (0x4cda70); then, without the contract's +0x45 flag, with +0x59 above 15 and +0x5b above 10, if draw(+0x59) is above 5: the news of thanks to the manager (0x58a070). No person or no award: the original ("Error" box).
